responsibility: Implements the tree-level CFG cleanup machinery that canonicalizes and simplifies GIMPLE control flow after transformations. It tracks altered blocks, folds constant control expressions and trivial switches, removes unreachable and redundant edges/blocks, cleans up call and noreturn flags, merges forwarders and PHI-only blocks, runs the post-optimization CFG cleanup pass, and provides the callgraph-aware unreachable-block deletion routine needed when dead CFG regions contain callgraph references or inline clones.
same_name_distinction: Implements the CFG-cleanup algorithms declared in tree-cfgcleanup.h, including simplification of control expressions and switches, block/edge removal and merging, post-optimization cleanup passes, and callgraph-aware unreachable-block deletion.
